lines.zh: 我背上背着弓，走过林子。
lines.en: Bow on my back, I cross the wood.

lines.zh: 箭筒在腰上磕着，我照走。
lines.en: My quiver knocks at my hip; I keep walking.

lines.zh: 我低头找掉落的好木料。
lines.en: I keep my head down for good fallen wood.
I go around a tree, studying its bark.
I check the string once more.

lines.zh: 我沿着老路走，路上没人。
lines.en: I take the old path; no one on it.

lines.zh: 我折了一根直枝，试了试弯。
lines.en: I break a straight twig and test its flex.
I walk and count the trees.

lines.zh: 我避开荆棘，袖子已经被钩破。
lines.en: I dodge the thorns; my sleeve's already torn.
I carry a bundle of shafts on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我踩断一根枯枝，停了一下。
lines.en: A dry branch snaps under me and I pause.
I sit and shave an arrow shaft.
I true each feather in turn.
I pluck the string and listen to the note.
I'm checking the grind on my arrowheads.

lines.zh: 太阳照在树皮上，我眯了眼。
lines.en: Sun on the bark makes me squint.
I spread my tools across my knees.
A bird calls; I look up.
I tie a bundle of arrows tight.
I'm waiting for the glue to dry.
There's sawdust under my nails.
I lay the bow across my knees.
Wind from the left will drift the shot.
I count the arrowheads I have left.
The tree shadow has moved an inch.

lines.zh: 你背着东西，不像砍柴的。
lines.en: You're carrying something; not a woodcutter.
I glance at your hands.
That arrow took me three days.
Buying arrows, or here to learn?
You're standing in the shooting lane.
I stand the bow upright.
You've got string calluses on your knuckles.
Don't touch that bundle; I just tied it.
The wood you want is to the north.
I'm blunt; don't take offense.
This wood belongs to the lord.
If you're crossing, be quick.
My hands can't stop working.

lines.zh: 你的靴子不适合走林子。
lines.en: Those boots are wrong for these woods.
I know every tree in this stand.
Did you hear that?

lines.zh: 我把箭搭在弦上，不是对着你。
lines.en: I nock an arrow — not at you.
If you have business, say it plainly.
I grunt and my hands jerk.
That landed on my forearm.
I put the bow in front of me.
Blood drips onto a shaft.
I take half a step back against a tree.
Teeth gritted, I re-string.
I check the wound; not deep.
I can still draw the bow.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的手感打没了。
lines.en: That knocked the feel out of my hands.
I right my quiver.
Good feathers — where from?
This wood is straight; I'll take it.
I'll trade two arrows for it.
What's your price?
I can get six shafts from this.
Keep it dry; strings hate water.
This head is new work.
I weigh it; it's heavy.
That's not enough to trade.
Careful — I've got blades in my hands.
You knocked me and I cut crooked.
That shaft's ruined.
I step behind a tree to clear the way.
That knocked my quiver over.

lines.zh: 对不起，我正低头看木头。
lines.en: Sorry, I was looking down at the wood.
We're crowded on this narrow track.
You've stepped on my bow.
Steady — don't snap the shafts.
I shift over a little.
There are finished bows hanging at home.
This one I'm keeping for her.
Someone's waiting for me to come eat.
I put the tools away one by one.
She hates the sawdust I track in.
This arrow's fletching is red.
I hang the quiver behind the door.
A string should be slackened for the night.
Working by lamplight is how you cut yourself.
It's dark; I should be getting back.
I pick up a fallen arrow.
This wood will make a fine stave.
I take a good feather.
This head's still sharp.
I slot it back into my quiver.
This string's snapped; leave it.

lines.zh: 我把石头上的箭杆收起。
lines.en: I gather the shafts off the stone.
I take a branch that fits my hand.
Someone dropped this; I'll hold it.
This would do as a counterweight.
Something's behind that tree.
I nock an arrow.
I turn side-on and make myself narrow.
It came from my left.
I draw to my jaw.
The wind is right; no aim-off needed.
I take half a step back to a tree.
I've picked its chest.
I'll give it two more steps.
This shot can't miss.
My hands are steady.
I let out half a breath and hold.
It won't know before the string speaks.
It's turned — good.
Now's the time.
I slide around to its flank.
I keep low and make no sound.

lines.zh: 它每走一步，我就换一个树。
lines.en: With each of its steps, I change trees.
I lift the arrowhead an inch.
It's sniffing; don't move.
I draw full and my arm is steady.
The wind shifted; I correct.
It's stopped inside my range.
I'm waiting for its flank.

lines.zh: 我拉开弓弦，箭头对准你。
lines.en: I draw the bowstring, arrowhead on you.
It looked back — that's it.
I've worked out where this will land.
The fletching brushes my fingers.
One more inch of drift from it.
The string trembles; I hold it.
It is about to move.
And now I release.
I release and the arrow's gone.
It's hit and staggers two steps back.
I nock another.
I turn the bow sideways to block.
I jab my shaft at its eye.
That arrow went through its shoulder.
I retreat while still drawing.
It charges; I sidestep.
I hit its leg.
Half my quiver's gone.
I put everything into that shot.
It hits a tree and drops.
I put one more in.

lines.zh: 我换了个位置，重新瞄准。
lines.en: I shift position and re-aim.
It's started to fear me.
I hold my ground and let it come.
The quiver hangs at my hip just right.
First the trees, then the wind.
I know this wood well.

lines.zh: 我在地上找个能做靶的东西。
lines.en: I look for something to use as a target.
I string the bow and test it.
Dew still sits on the leaves.
I plant my feet.
Birds burst up in the distance.

lines.zh: 我抽出一支箭，试了试羽。
lines.en: I draw an arrow and test the fletching.
Few people use this track.

lines.zh: 我把工具袋放在树根下。
lines.en: I set my tool bag at a tree root.
The smell of cut wood is good.
I look up into the canopy.
Every new trade passes through me.
The first arrow goes on the string.
I'm waiting for a moving target.
There's not a sound nearby.
Fire catches the string and it snaps.

lines.zh: 我从树上掉下来，脚崴了。
lines.en: I fall out of a tree and twist my ankle.

lines.zh: 水灌进嘴里，我抓不住岸边。
lines.en: Water floods my mouth and I can't grip the bank.
The blast throws my quiver off.

lines.zh: 有人用跟我一样的东西打中了我。
lines.en: Someone hit me with a thing just like mine.

lines.zh: 有什么缠住了我的手指。
lines.en: Something has bound my fingers.
My hands shake too much to draw full.

lines.zh: 雷落在我的弓上，我整条手臂都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits my bow and my whole arm goes numb.

lines.zh: 脚下的林子没了，我往下掉。
lines.en: The wood under me is gone and I fall.
